authorities.header_read_method: For each named tensor, read the owning shard's 20-byte GRAVITY prefix, declared JSON header, and exactly the tensor's fixed 64-byte GLM52CPK codec header. No tensor body beyond those fixed codec headers was read and no descriptor payload hash was recomputed.

logical_row_layout.content_key_row: row = head * 448 + key_dim, head in 0..64, key_dim in 0..192
logical_row_layout.value_row: row = head * 448 + 192 + value_dim, head in 0..64, value_dim in 0..256
logical_row_layout.codes_layout: one direct u8 code per logical row/chunk because bits=8 and subspaces=1

runtime_gpu_weight_resource_bytes.definition: f16 codebook + packed code stream + current four-byte tail padding; excludes the fixed 64-byte on-disk codec header

extra_unreachable_sealed_pair.finding: The sealed weight map also carries model.layers.78 self-attention tensors, but architecture.num_hidden_layers is 78 and current runtime loops 0..78, so this pair is not one of the 78 runtime-reachable layers.

kv_b_proj.codec_shape_and_pq_header: identical to the 78 runtime-reachable kv_b_proj tensors

o_proj.codec_shape_and_pq_header: identical to the 78 runtime-reachable o_proj tensors

buffers: u8 packed codes with four-byte tail
current_kernel_abi.params: eight u32 values: dim, subspaces, sub, card, rows, cols, nchunk, bits
current_kernel_abi.operation: one logical row-major W @ x over every row
missing: logical row base or row map
input/output buffer offsets in the resident encoder helper

absorbed_k_transpose_query.operation: For each head and latent column: q_latent[head,col] = sum_key_dim W[head*448+key_dim,col] * q_nope[head,key_dim].
absorbed_k_transpose_query.reason: Every required W element is directly addressable as codebook[codes[(row*16)+(col/32)]][col%32], but the current kernel only computes W @ x and has no transpose gather.
absorbed_k_transpose_query.minimal_shader_change: One transpose-gather PQ kernel whose output grid is [64,512] and whose inner reduction visits key_dim 0..192 in ascending order.

per_head_v_weighted_latent.reason: The row-wise dot is the existing PQ primitive, but the 64 heads require 64 different 512-wide inputs and 64 discontiguous 256-row windows within the interleaved K/V matrix.
per_head_v_weighted_latent.absolute_minimum_reuse_path: Expose codes-buffer and output-buffer offsets and encode 64 existing gravity_pq_matvec dispatches, each with rows=256 and codes starting at (head*448+192)*16 bytes.
per_head_v_weighted_latent.preferred_minimal_production_kernel: One head-batched row-window PQ kernel with input stride 512, output stride 256, per-head row stride 448, and value-row offset 192.

o_proj.reason: Compact and reconstruction paths both produce the existing head-major 16384-wide context, exactly the W @ x shape already accepted by gravity_pq_matvec.

selected_position_full_kv_reconstruction.operation: For each selected position, run the existing [28672,512] kv_b_proj W @ latent and materialize all heads' [192 K | 256 V] rows.
selected_position_full_kv_reconstruction.current_encoder_gap: The resident helper binds x and y at offset zero. Materializing many selected positions into one scratch buffer requires buffer-offset support or separate output buffers.
one_command_buffer_options: Encode 2048 existing matvec dispatches with selected latent input offsets and expanded-output offsets after adding offset arguments to the host encoder.
Add one selected-batch PQ kernel that reads the ranked/ascending position buffer and writes [selected,28672] directly.

compact_state_layout.ownership_note: The literal floor preserves current source's allocation of an index-key buffer for every layer. The maximal floor assigns index-key storage only to the 21 full-indexer layers; changing that ownership is separate production work.

scratch_for_concrete_ranked_kernel.reuse: The compact attention kernel completes every score read for one head, barriers, then overwrites that head's q_latent region with its weighted latent.

minimum_dispatch_dag_after_inputs_exist: compact-cache append: normalized latent[512] and rotated shared RoPE tail[64] -> cache at current position
PQ K-transpose kernel: q_nope plus kv_b codebooks/codes -> q_latent[64,512]
compact ranked attention kernel waits on K-transpose, compact-cache append, rotated q_rope, and the DSA ranked selected-position buffer; it writes weighted_latent[64,512]
head-batched PQ V-row kernel waits on weighted_latent and writes context[64,256]
existing gravity_pq_matvec o_proj waits on context and writes hidden[6144]

ordering_and_v21_contract.selected_position_producer: current topk_desc is stable descending with lower global position winning ties
ordering_and_v21_contract.required_attention_input: the stable DSA rank list itself, not an ascending allow bitmap
ordering_and_v21_contract.score_order_from_cpu_proof: latent dimensions ascending, then shared RoPE dimensions ascending, scale after the complete dot
ordering_and_v21_contract.weighted_latent_order: the same stable DSA rank order
ordering_and_v21_contract.v_projection_order_from_cpu_proof: latent dimensions ascending per value row
ordering_and_v21_contract.proof_result: On the deterministic CPU fixture, ranked accumulation passes V2.1; copying current sparse_attend's ascending-position scan fails only max meaningful relative error at 1.1059935866029965e-5 > 1e-5.
ordering_and_v21_contract.gpu_caveat: The proof does not authorize explicit Metal fma or parallel score reductions. A production kernel must retain ranked selected-position traversal and separately pass FP64 V2.1 plus exact DSA top-k, attention top-k, and final token decisions.

one_pass_materialized_scratch.rope_note: No 32-MiB per-head RoPE duplication is included; the reconstructed-attention kernel reads the selected token's shared 64-wide RoPE cache directly.

current_kernel_dispatch_dag_after_select: compact-cache append writes latent and shared RoPE for the current token
encode 2048 existing gravity_pq_matvec dispatches, each reading one selected 512-wide latent and writing one 28672-wide expanded K/V slice
a reconstructed sparse-attention kernel waits on all reconstruction writes, reads content K/V plus shared RoPE, and produces context
existing gravity_pq_matvec o_proj waits on context

low_scratch_two_full_pass_variant.description: Reuse one 28672-f32 reconstruction buffer, first storing all head logits, then rerun every full kv_b projection after softmax to accumulate values.
low_scratch_two_full_pass_variant.verdict: Feasible but strictly worse in compute; retained only as the exact memory/compute tradeoff.

ordering_and_v21_contract.source_equivalent_order: To reproduce the current expanded formulation, accumulate softmax and values in ascending global-position order. The deterministic fixture's expanded path passes V2.1 in that order.
ordering_and_v21_contract.selection_decision: The exact stable DSA ranked top-k list must still be retained and compared before deriving the ascending attention traversal.
ordering_and_v21_contract.distinction_from_absorbed: The ranked-order requirement proven for compact absorption must not be blindly applied to source-equivalent expanded reconstruction; reassociation differs by formulation.
ordering_and_v21_contract.gpu_caveat: Any batch reconstruction and reconstructed-attention kernels still require FP64 V2.1 and exact decision gates.

scheduled_weight_resource_bytes.definition: Static source-style resource accounting, not measured DRAM traffic or a benchmark. Current runtime counts resident codebook+codes+four-byte-tail per PQ matvec call; caches may serve repeated accesses.

absorbed.note: K-transpose and V-row kernels share one kv_b resource. Actual active-byte accounting should count only the row-code windows each kernel addresses and disclose codebook rereads.

selected_reconstruction_current_kernel.note: This is the current ledger convention for 2048 full-matrix PQ calls, not a claim that 976 MB reaches DRAM.

persistent_cache_resources_per_layer: index_key_cache f32 [capacity,128] only for full indexer owners in the maximal layout
common_sequence_resources: stable ranked selected_position u32 [min(index_topk,n_keys)] and selected_count
sequence-sized DSA scores and selection scratch grown with session capacity

resources: kv_b codes u8 [28672,16] plus four-byte safety tail
pq_weight_view.lifetime: Clone/pin both Metal buffers until the command buffer completes; an LRU entry must not be evicted while encoded commands reference it.

source_feasibility_conflicts.conflict: This isolated branch still allocates ActPool.idx_scores for only 8192 floats while full-indexer scoring writes pos+1 values.
source_feasibility_conflicts.impact: Position 8192 requires 8193 scores; this branch alone is not a safe 32K runtime even though the compact state floor fits.
source_feasibility_conflicts.integration_context: A sequence-scratch repair was integrated separately on live main as 27fe89b5 with receipt 3f8a4e04. This audit does not duplicate or modify it.

source_feasibility_conflicts.conflict: The current resident path expands kv_b for the new token and caches per-head K/V before DSA; it has no compact cache type or PQ weight-view ABI for attention kernels.
source_feasibility_conflicts.impact: The state floor is architectural, not reachable by a flag or allocation-only change.

source_feasibility_conflicts.conflict: Dormant gravity_glm_sparse_attn consumes expanded K/V. Its rank-list/threadgroup-score structure is reusable, but its buffers and arithmetic are not the compact formulation.
source_feasibility_conflicts.impact: A new compact kernel and sealed-tensor V2.1 gate are mandatory.

verdict.absorbed_compact_attention: PRODUCTION-FEASIBLE FROM THE CURRENT SEALED PQ REPRESENTATION, BUT NOT WITH THE CURRENT KERNEL ABI. It needs a direct PQ transpose-gather K kernel, ranked compact attention, and head-batched V row-window kernel. No dense kv_b reconstruction or artifact rewrite is required.
verdict.selected_position_reconstruction: EXECUTABLE WITH CURRENT PQ MATVEC MATH AND NO DENSE WEIGHT RECONSTRUCTION, BUT NOT A VIABLE PRIMARY 2048-TOPK DESIGN: about 30.13 billion MACs and 224 MiB of expanded K/V scratch per layer, or twice the PQ work for a low-scratch two-pass form.
verdict.preferred_lane: Implement and parity-gate the absorbed compact ABI first. Retain selected-position reconstruction only as a source-equivalent correctness oracle/fallback for bounded fixtures.
verdict.state: Both strategies share the same 6.703125-GiB literal or 5.8125-GiB full-indexer-only 32K state floor; reconstruction's 224-MiB scratch is reusable across serialized layers and is not persistent per-token state.
verdict.promotion: No promotion is authorized by this read-only audit. Required next evidence is tiny real-header/kernel parity, then sealed-model complete-token V2.1 with exact DSA selections and emitted tokens, followed by measured 2K/8K/32K memory and latency.
